summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a 6-K reporting open-market purchases of its own shares on Euronext Milan under the second tranche of a buyback program approved by the Shareholders' Meeting on 6 May 2026, intended to fund additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends. Between 2 and 6 November 2026 Eni bought 4,455,629 shares (0.15% of capital) at a weighted average of EUR 25.81 for EUR 114,999,935.11. Since the 8 May 2026 start, 97,764,152 shares (3.23%) were acquired for EUR 2.285bn; total treasury holdings reach 184,592,259 shares, or 6.10% of capital. Daily tranches ran about EUR 23m. Watch execution pace, average cost versus spot, and any cancellation or remuneration resolution affecting share count.
